senses.zh: 模式化的思想；老一套；旧框框
senses.en: a belief or idea of what a particular type of person or thing is like
examples: Current evidence indicates that older people are more healthy than popular [[stereotypes]] suggest.

senses.en: the fact of being important and well-known
examples: His rise to [[prominence]] would not have been possible without the war.

senses.en: feelings of pity, love, sadness, etc. that are often considered to be too strong or not suitable for a particular situation
examples: He was overwhelmed by [[sentiment]] as he thought of his wife.
Public [[sentiment]] is against any change to the law.

senses.en: (fml.) an opinion or feeling you have about sth.
examples: He was overwhelmed by [[sentiment]] as he thought of his wife.
Public [[sentiment]] is against any change to the law.

senses.zh: （指气质或外貌）女性特有的；女性的
senses.en: having the qualities or appearance considered to be typical of women; connected with women
examples: Amelia's report describes the experience from a [[feminine]] point of view.

senses.en: connected with literature
examples: In a [[literary]] essay, you should explore the meaning and construction of the text.

senses.en: having feelings that are typical of a caring mother toward a child
examples: She seems to have a strong [[maternal]] instinct.

senses.en: to a much greater level or degree than seems reasonable or appropriate
examples: The country relies [[excessively]] on borrowing from abroad.

senses.en: the fact of being male or female
examples: It is a country where [[gender]] roles have remained largely unchanged.

senses.en: the unfair difference between groups of people in society, when some have more wealth, status, or opportunities than others
examples: There has been an increase in economic [[inequality]] between different areas of the country.

senses.en: an unfair personal opinion that influences your judgment
examples: It's clear that the company has a [[bias]] against women.

senses.en: a magazine, esp. one about a serious or technical subject
examples: Readers will find a complete list of [[periodicals]] dealing with that subject.

senses.en: the act of printing a book, a magazine, etc. and making it available to the public; a book, a magazine, etc. that has been published
examples: That professor was the author of 70 major scientific [[publications]].

senses.en: (BrE analyse) examine or think about sth. carefully, in order to understand it
examples: We use a special computer program to [[analyze]] all the sales figures.

senses.en: recognize and correctly name sb. / sth.
examples: Passengers were asked to [[identify]] their own suitcases before they were put on the plane.

senses.en: a statement, letter, etc. that shows that sth. is true, correct, or definite
examples: I'm still waiting for [[confirmation]] of the test results.

senses.en: acting or happening in a way that is expected
examples: In March and April, the weather in this area is much less [[predictable]].

senses.zh: 异乎寻常的；令人惊奇的
senses.en: very unusual or surprising
examples: These myths have a [[startling]] likeness to one another.

senses.zh: 特有的；特别的；有特色的
senses.en: having a quality or characteristic that makes sth. different and easily noticed
examples: Whatever you think of his poetry, it's certainly [[distinctive]].

senses.zh: 完全相同的；极为相似的
senses.en: exactly the same, or very similar
examples: The picture is [[identical]] to the one in The Museum of Modern Art in New York.

senses.en: (only before noun) done in a planned and determined way, esp. by more than one person, government, country, etc.
examples: Libraries have made a [[concerted]] effort to attract young people.

senses.zh: （关于某主题的）演讲，论述，著述
senses.en: a serious speech or piece of writing on a particular subject
examples: Hastings responds with a lengthy [[discourse]] on marketing strategies.

senses.zh: （数）量的；与数量有关的；定量的
senses.en: (fml.) relating to amounts rather than to the quality or standard of sth.
examples: We need to do a proper [[quantitative]] analysis of this problem.

senses.en: the fact of having sb. to speak, vote, or make decisions for you
examples: Minority groups need more effective parliamentary [[representation]].

senses.zh: 微不足道的；没有什么价值的
senses.en: not serious, important, or valuable
examples: I know it sounds [[trivial]], but I'm worried about it.

senses.en: easy to see or notice; clear or definite
examples: Road noise tends to be more [[noticeable]] in certain weather conditions.

senses.en: hide sth. or change it, so that it cannot be recognized
examples: The speech was seen by many as a thinly [[disguised]] attack on the president.
He [[disguised]] himself by wearing a false beard.

senses.en: change sb.'s appearance so that people cannot recognize them
examples: The speech was seen by many as a thinly [[disguised]] attack on the president.
He [[disguised]] himself by wearing a false beard.

senses.zh: （感情、思想等）无意识的，未意识到的
senses.en: (of feelings, thoughts, etc.) existing or happening without you realizing or being aware; not deliberate or controlled
examples: He seems to be driven by an [[unconscious]] desire to do better than everyone else.
They found him lying [[unconscious]] on the floor.

senses.zh: 不省人事的；失去知觉的
senses.en: unable to see, move, feel, etc. in the normal way because you are not conscious
examples: He seems to be driven by an [[unconscious]] desire to do better than everyone else.
They found him lying [[unconscious]] on the floor.

senses.zh: （书、报纸等的）出版者，出版商；出版社
senses.en: a person or company whose business is to arrange the writing, production, and sale of books, newspapers, etc.
examples: The [[publisher]] planned to produce the journal on a weekly basis.

senses.en: continue doing an activity or trying to achieve sth. over a long period of time
examples: Students should [[pursue]] their own interests, as well as do their school work.

senses.en: the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way
examples: Laws have got to be tougher to stop [[discrimination]] against the disabled.

senses.en: become important, famous, powerful, etc.
at issue or in question
examples: His own personal future was [[at stake]].

乔治・亨利・刘易斯（英国哲学家、文学评论家和剧作家）
